resources.string: Choose how Minecraft looks for this profile. The game itself is untouched: the custom look is a small resource pack the launcher builds for the exact game version and enables before each launch.
Switching back to Vanilla removes the launcher pack from the active list and restores your previous settings. Your own packs, worlds and mods are never touched.
